purpose: Observed full-room composition above ACT; not local-grasp qualification

new_execution.scope: sock and basket in different observed positions; two rooms with door
new_execution.search: RGB semantic model with registered depth and two exposures; scanned free viewpoints
new_execution.navigation: map/scan planning with current robot and payload footprint; measured position and heading feedback
new_execution.manipulation: actual frozen ACT inference; externally planned base motion; no teacher fallback
new_execution.phase_handoff: training-derived experimental clock/pose proposals requiring separate full-room qualification
new_execution.acceptance: ten diagnostic scenes then two independent groups of ten; per-substep independent collision audit
new_execution.evidence: all prior data retained; separate checksummed inactive Jetson package and whole-cycle evidence archive
new_execution.correction: Cause-directed completed rollout diagnosis; 24 automated full-scene expert attempts, successful full missions only; historical data plus new phase recordings; actual one-ACT warm-start, >=8 full passes, physical checkpoint comparison
new_execution.neural_teacher_distinction: Observed geometric demonstrations are simulation-only data sources; never substituted for ACT in independent room validation or Jetson execution
new_execution.failure_policy: Up to three evidence-driven neural corrections; search, navigation, collisions outside actor phases and teacher faults require algorithm diagnosis rather than blind gradient retries
new_execution.data_quality: Old train/validation identities and samples checksums retained; successful correction targets get replay weight4; final room scenes never enter training
